title: Career guidance and easier updates
items: Complete a skills assessment and save interests to receive initial career, job, and training suggestions, including paths for people without a resume or NC certificate.
Browse the full patch history from the website or mobile app, newest updates first.
Career Seekers can apply for verified job openings in the mobile app and follow their application status and PESO feedback.
PESO administrators can review job applications in the mobile app, update their status, and provide a reason when an applicant is not selected.

title: Workspace and account improvements
items: Admin user management can create accounts with secure initial passwords, and mobile account forms show password strength.
Messages update in real time across the website and mobile app while connected, with automatic catch-up if the connection drops.
Use grouped role navigation, clearly labeled mobile tabs, and next-step workflows.
Career Seekers and PESO administrators can use PESO AI and document scanning; training staff see role-specific tools.
Scholarship listings show eligibility, application requirements, provider assessments, and source links.
Browse DOLE PhilJobNet vacancies and TESDA training catalog information.
Workspace forms preserve entered details when validation needs correction.
The mobile app retries saved sign-in when the server becomes reachable or the app resumes, and reports clearer connection errors.
Retry scan history and keep selected files available after a failed scan.

title: Live message updates
items: Messages sync between the website and mobile app in real time while connected, then catch up automatically after a connection drop.

title: Clearer catalog and workflow records
items: Training, job, scholarship, and activity records are visible for workflow practice, with their descriptions identifying fictional records where applicable.

title: More reliable document scanning
items: Scanner uploads use the same API address and connection handling as other mobile requests.
Retry scan history, and keep selected files available after an upload or scan fails.
Android and iOS builds normalize the website URL before configuring the API address.

title: More complete training and scholarship details
items: Scholarship listings show eligibility, application requirements, provider assessments, and source links.
Browse job vacancies from DOLE PhilJobNet and updated TESDA catalog records.
Career Seekers and PESO staff can use career guidance and document scanning; training staff see the tools for their role.

title: Role-based next steps
items: Dashboards show role-specific next actions on the website and mobile app.
Use the Career Seeker, TESDA, and document-scanner labels consistently across the app.

title: Clearer loading and form recovery
items: Mobile navigation responds immediately when changing sections, and the website shows a loading state while new pages open.
Web management forms keep entered details when validation needs correction.
The app waits for slow server responses and distinguishes connection timeouts from secure connection errors.

title: Mobile connection recovery
items: The app waits longer for a slow server before reporting a connection problem.
Retry a saved sign-in when the server becomes reachable again or the app resumes.
See clearer messages for slow responses and secure connection problems.
Browse jobs, scholarships, training centers, and training sessions; apply for training and track requests and assessment records.

title: Training and opportunity workflows on mobile
items: Browse jobs, scholarships, training centers, and training sessions.
Apply for training and track applications and assessment records.
Staff can manage centers, trainers, schedules, and opportunities according to their role.
See release notes after installing an app update.
